concepts.gloss_en: names (shemot; plural of שֵׁם — including the Divine Names)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the word שֵׁמוֹת ('names', plural of שֵׁם) — in lm1:1 the Divine Names engraved on the clubs that beat the yetzer hara, and in lm2:39 'names' as the ultimate purpose (explicitly derived via 'do not read shamot/desolations but shemot/names'). The desolations form שַׁמּוֹת appears in that paragraph only as the verse being re-read, and is not the tagged concept. Same word throughout, no homograph split needed.
